# Baking Bread at Home

To bake a good loaf of bread, start by proofing your yeast in warm water
with a pinch of sugar until it turns foamy. Mix the yeast into flour and
salt, then knead the dough for about ten minutes until it becomes smooth
and elastic. Let the dough rise in a warm spot until it doubles in size,
then shape it into a loaf and bake in a hot oven until the crust turns
golden brown and the loaf sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom.

# Pasta Carbonara

Carbonara is a simple Roman pasta dish made with eggs, hard cheese,
cured pork, and black pepper. Cook the pasta in salted boiling water
while you crisp up the pancetta in a pan. Off the heat, toss the hot
pasta with beaten eggs and grated cheese so the residual heat creates a
creamy sauce without scrambling the eggs. Finish with cracked black
pepper and extra cheese before serving immediately.
